thread:
emma: Pls help 1 partners reported unexpected line-item rates on last month's AWS marketplace statements. Looks like some SKUs billed at the wrong ratecard bucket. Anyone know if ratecard rollup job ran overnight?

lucas: I see anomalies in the `ratecard_assignments` table for marketplace channel. Some SKUs mapped to `enterprise_discount` bucket instead of `channel-standard`. Could be a join condition regression in the rollup.

priya: Example sanitized invoice row: 
```
invoice: 100244 | partner: blueorchid | sku: RW-MARKET-EMBED | qty: 10 | unit_list: 12.00 | applied_rate: 6.00 | expected_rate: 9.60 | net_usd: 60.00
```
Applied rate 6.00 matches enterprise bucket, expected 9.60 for channel-standard.

maya: How many partners impacted and what's the exposure?

lucas: Quick count: 21 partners, ~47 invoice lines, estimated revenue delta ~$7,800 under-billed. Uploading CSV now.

billing-bot: Report uploaded: https://drive.redwood/finance/marketplace-ratebucket-2005550000.csv. job-id: rb_2005550000.

emma: Pause auto-billing acceptance for marketplace until we confirm. Partner-success - prepare comms offering corrected statements and a reconciliation call.

partner-success: On it. We'll prioritize any partner with net change > $500.

priya: Root cause looks like the rollup uses `partner_tier` from a stale cache key during the midnight job. I'll push a cache-bust and re-run the rollup; then we should recompute affected invoices. Need finance approval for recompute window and any downstream payment gateway adjustments.

emma: Approve recompute for affected invoice range. Finance OK to post corrective invoices and adjustments; for partners with disputes, escalate to contracts if > $2k. Keep legal notified only if they push back.

lucas: Rolling back cache and re-running rollup now. Will post results and a list of recompute invoice_ids when done. ETA ~12m.

billing-bot: Rollup rerun started by lucas; est completion 12m. run-id: roll_2005550000_1

emma: Thanks team. Keep updates here and add final reconciliation CSV to the finance folder.

partner-success: Draft comms ready; will tailor to each partner after we have final numbers.
notes: Cause: ratecard rollup used stale cache leading to incorrect bucket assignment (enterprise vs channel-standard) for marketplace SKUs. Impact: 21 partners, ~47 lines, ~$7.8k revenue under-billed. Actions: pause billing acceptance, cache-bust + rollup rerun, invoice recompute, partner comms, escalate >$2k disputes to contracts.
